newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Trading in S.Korean Jinro shares halted.
newsitem.headline: Trading in S.Korean Jinro shares halted.

text.p: The Korea Stock Exchange on Tuesday suspended trading in common and preferred shares of Jinro Ltd on rumours that the company had defaulted on debt repayments, an exchange official said.
The timing for resumption of trading has not yet been set, the official said.
"The exchange will decide later on when the trading will resume after Jinro makes an official announcement," he said.
Jinro's common shares last traded at 9,070 won and its preferred shares at 3,960.

The Commercial Bank of Korea, the prime creditor bank for Jinro Ltd's parent Jinro Group, said on Monday it would bail out six Jinro affiliates under an earlier agreement with other banks to help finance the troubled group.
